answer: Because the vault reference is updated at each comet checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the sparrow audit records how much each answer added. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 6 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Repeating an already-covered mechanism thus earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 68 aliases however many keys the operator holds. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
